name: text-plugin-1
note: Six prompts that start the plugin-creator interview. A plugin made that way is DATA: a field of work for the setup wizard (goals, and the skills, teams and connectors that really exist), nothing runs and no code is written; a goal with nothing real behind it gets a 'soon' line. Two for business, two for education, two for research.

entry.name: Café field pack
entry.line: A plugin for a small café: stock, rota and customer messages

cells.request: Create a plugin for a small café owner: a field of work for the setup wizard, with nothing to run. First ask me for two to five goals (for example keeping stock right, planning the weekly rota, answering customers) and the languages to add. For each goal propose, from what really exists, the skills, teams and connectors that fit, and let me cut. A goal with nothing real behind it gets a 'soon' line, never an invented skill. Show me the pack in plain words, wait for my yes, write the draft, then tell me where to install it.
